dismissArrangeArea.name: Dismiss Troop Arrangement Area
dismissArrangeArea.hint: Clears the advisory area shown after a troop moves, releasing the anchor and letting segments move freely again.

troopReduced.message: {name} is reduced to {segments} segments. Maximum Hit Points are capped at {hp} until the troop recovers (remove the Troop Reduced effect after downtime recovery).
troopReduced.healCapped: {name}: healing capped at {hp} HP while the troop is reduced.

dropArt.name: Art for dropped troops
dropArt.hint: Which piece a troop token gets when it is dropped on a map without art of its own. Tactical is the battle token; strategy is the map piece. Either can be swapped per token from the token HUD.
